  SELECT 
    o.order_id, 
    AVG(rv.review_score) AS calificacion, 
    julianday(o.order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(o.order_estimated_delivery_date) AS dias_retraso
  FROM vw_pedidos_validos o
  JOIN order_reviews rv ON rv.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  GROUP BY o.order_id
),
rangos_retraso AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN dias_retraso <= 0 THEN 'a_tiempo'
      WHEN dias_retraso <= 3 THEN '1-3'
      WHEN dias_retraso <= 7 THEN '4-7'
      WHEN dias_retraso <= 14 THEN '8-14'
      ELSE '15+'

    COUNT(*) AS pedidos, 
    AVG(calificacion) AS calificacion_promedio, 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN calificacion <= 2 THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) * 100 AS pct_calificacion_baja
  FROM pedidos_validos
  GROUP BY rango_retraso
)
SELECT

  (SELECT pct_calificacion_baja FROM rangos_retraso WHERE rango_retraso = 'a_tiempo') AS pct_calificacion_baja_a_tiempo
FROM rangos_retraso
WHERE pct_calificacion_baja >= 2 * (SELECT pct_calificacion_baja FROM rangos_retraso WHERE rango_retraso

  COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) AS num_vendedores, 
  SUM(ingresos) AS ingresos_total
FROM (
  SELECT 
    oi.seller_id, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') THEN oi.price ELSE 0 END) AS ingresos,
    AVG(CASE WHEN o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND rv.review_id IS NOT NULL THEN rv.review_score ELSE NULL END) AS calificacion,
    AVG(CASE WHEN o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND rv.review_id IS NOT NULL THEN julianday(odcd.order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(oed.order_estimated_delivery_date) ELSE NULL END) AS dias_retraso,
    COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS num_pedidos
  FROM vw_pedidos_validos o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  LEFT JOIN order_reviews rv ON rv.order_id = o.order_id
  LEFT JOIN orders oed ON oed.order_id = o.order_id
  LEFT JOIN orders odc ON odc.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE num_pedidos >= 30
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id
) AS subconsulta
WHERE calificacion < 3.5 OR dias_retraso > 0.15 * num_pedidos
ORDER BY ingresos DESC
LIMIT 0.25 * COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id)
